modes.name: Classic
modes.desc: Eat fruit, grow longer, avoid the walls and yourself.

modes.name: Wall
modes.desc: Every fruit you eat drops a new wall somewhere on the board.

modes.name: Portal
modes.desc: Fruit comes in pairs. Eat one and you pop out of the other.

modes.name: Cheese
modes.desc: Your body is full of holes you can slither through.

modes.name: Borderless
modes.desc: Leave one side of the board, come back on the other.

modes.name: Twin
modes.desc: Each fruit flips you around: your tail becomes your head.

modes.name: Yin Yang
modes.desc: Control two mirrored snakes at once. Don't let them touch.

modes.name: Key
modes.desc: Fruit is locked. Grab its key first to open it.

modes.name: Sokoban
modes.desc: Push fruit onto the targets instead of eating it.

modes.name: Poison
modes.desc: Half the fruit is poison, and it swaps every time you eat.

modes.name: Dimension
modes.desc: Walls live in two dimensions. Eating flips which one is solid.

modes.name: Minesweeper
modes.desc: Hidden mines. Numbers on visited cells count nearby mines.

modes.name: Statue
modes.desc: Eating turns your body to stone. Keep going with what's left.

modes.name: Light
modes.desc: The board is dark. Only your head lights the way.

modes.name: Shield
modes.desc: Pick up shields that let you survive one crash.

modes.name: Arrow
modes.desc: Arrow tiles force you to turn the way they point.

modes.name: Magnet
modes.desc: Fruit near your head gets pulled toward you.

modes.name: Gate
modes.desc: Gates open and close on a timer. Time your runs.

categories.name: Sprint 10
categories.desc: Eat 10 apples on a 10 x 9 board.

categories.name: Sprint 25
categories.desc: Eat 25 apples on a 10 x 9 board.

categories.name: Sprint 30
categories.desc: 5 apples at a time on a big board. Eat 30.

categories.name: Sprint 50
categories.desc: Eat 50 apples on a 12 x 11 board.

categories.name: Marathon
categories.desc: 3 apples at a time on a big board. Eat 100.

categories.name: Blitz
categories.desc: Top speed from the first move. Eat 15.

categories.name: Accelerate
categories.desc: Starts slow, gets faster with every apple. Eat 30.

categories.name: Full Board
categories.desc: Fill every cell of an 8 x 5 board.

categories.name: Portal Dash
categories.desc: Portal mode: eat 15 and ride the portals.

categories.name: Wall Gauntlet
categories.desc: Wall mode: every apple adds a wall. Eat 20.

categories.name: Key Hunt
categories.desc: Key mode: grab each key, then its apple. Eat 10.

categories.name: Twin Turns
categories.desc: Twin mode: you flip around after every apple. Eat 15.

categories.name: Minefield
categories.desc: Minesweeper mode: avoid the hidden mines. Eat 15.

categories.name: Turbo
categories.desc: Accelerate, but harder: faster sooner, down to top speed. Eat 40.

categories.name: Wrap Run
categories.desc: Borderless mode: leave one side, come back on the other. Eat 20.

categories.name: Poison Path
categories.desc: Poison mode: half the fruit is poison and it swaps. Eat 15.

categories.name: Gate Runner
categories.desc: Gate mode: time your runs through the gates. Eat 15.

categories.name: Lights Out
categories.desc: Light mode: only your head lights the way. Eat 15.

categories.name: Dimension Drift
categories.desc: Dimension mode: eating flips which walls are solid. Eat 15.

categories.name: Swiss Sprint
categories.desc: Cheese mode: slither through the holes in your body. Eat 20.

categories.name: Statue Garden
categories.desc: Statue mode: eating turns your body to stone. Eat 15.

categories.name: Snail Pace
categories.desc: The slowest speed: plan every move. Eat 20.

categories.name: Big Board
categories.desc: One apple at a time on a 30 x 20 board. Eat 20.

categories.name: Fruit Salad
categories.desc: Mixed fruit, 5 at a time. Eat 40.

categories.name: Shield Rush
categories.desc: Shield mode: grab shields to survive a crash. Eat 15.

categories.name: Arrow Maze
categories.desc: Arrow mode: arrow tiles turn you. Eat 15.

categories.name: Magnet Pull
categories.desc: Magnet mode: nearby fruit flies to you. Eat 25.

categories.name: Yin Yang
categories.desc: Steer two mirrored snakes at once. Eat 10.

categories.name: Chaos
categories.desc: Wall, Gate and Arrow modes at once. Eat 15.
